title: Cephi Tool
description: A tool Cephi's AI can call. One file per tool in %APPDATA%\Cephi\tools\ (subfolders allowed). Changes are loaded immediately.

name.description: Unique technical name used by the model.

title.description: Display name in the UI: a plain string or per language, e.g. { "en": "Weather", "de": "Wetter" }.

description.description: When and what the tool is used for. The model decides based on this text alone: be specific. English recommended (small models select tools more reliably).

keywords.description: Words people use for this tool, e.g. "Arbeitsspeicher RAM CPU": a plain string or per language. With a local model only the tools that fit the request are offered, and a German question rarely shares words with an English description.

enabled.description: false = the tool is not loaded.

permission.description: auto = run immediately, confirm = ask first (default).

triggers.description: Fast path: phrases that run the tool immediately without asking the AI. Syntax: {parameter} captures text, (a|b) alternatives, [optional]. Case-insensitive. May contain phrases in several languages.

args.description: Fixed parameter values for this trigger.

afterTrigger.description: After a trigger ran the tool: show = only show the result (fastest). answer = show the result, then let the AI answer from it (e.g. summarize search results).

parameters.description: Parameters the model fills in (JSON schema object with simple values).

description.description: Helps the model fill in the value correctly.

default.description: Value used when the model omits the parameter.

template.description: Text with {{parameter}} placeholders. Filters: {{name|raw}}, {{name|url}}, {{name|json}}. API keys from the vault: {{secret:name}}.

then.description: Opens a URL/URI with the default handler. Placeholders are URL-encoded. A scheme fixed in the template (e.g. ms-settings:) is allowed, otherwise only http/https.

target.description: browser = default browser or the app for the scheme. cephi = Cephi's web tab (http/https only). orbit = old name of cephi.

then.description: Starts a program directly (no shell). %ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES% are expanded, empty arguments dropped.
Runs a fixed PowerShell script. Parameters are available as $env:CEPHI_ARG_<NAME> ({{placeholders}} are not allowed, to prevent code injection). The output goes to the model.
HTTP request; the response body goes to the model. Placeholders: URL-encoded in url, raw in headers, JSON in body.

id.description: Required parameters: clipboard_write → text · open_app → name · spotify_play → query (optional kind) · media_control → action (optional level, amount) · radio → device, state · web_search → query · fetch_page → url · translate → text (optional to).
